title: Director, Business Development
description:
Overview

The Opportunity: Join Avantor as a Director of Strategic Business Development and drive strategic growth across a portfolio of competitively held accounts in the Midwest region. This global-facing role is designed for a strategic hunter who excels at building executive-level relationships, leading cross-functional initiatives, and unlocking new opportunities in both biopharma and industrial sectors. You’ll serve as a key liaison for high-value accounts, aligning internal stakeholders across sales, supply chain, pricing, and contracts to deliver exceptional customer value and position Avantor as a trusted partner in scientific and industrial advancement. The ideal candidate will be located in the Midwest area to enable close collaboration with key stakeholders and must be willing to travel up to 50% to customer sites and internal meetings.

What we are looking for

  • Education: College degree or equivalent/applicable experience required

  • Experience: 5+ years of business development or sales experience in a solution-based, B2B environment.

    • Proven success managing high-level customer relationships and leading cross-functional teams

    • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence across all organizational levels

    • Experience in pricing strategy, contract negotiation, and vendor relationship management

    • Familiarity with biopharma, industrial, or life sciences sectors preferred

    • Valid driver’s license required due to travel expectations

  • Collaboration Tool: Proficiency with CRM systems, using data to manage pipelines and optimize performance

How you will thrive and create an impact

You will thrive by developing and executing strategic account plans, building trust with senior decision-makers, and collaborating across internal teams to deliver tailored solutions. Your ability to navigate complex customer environments and drive alignment across sales teams will be key to unlocking growth and delivering value across a diverse account portfolio. Collaborate with Regional Directors, VPs, and Sales Representatives to support state-specific programs and initiatives.

  • Lead strategic business development efforts across a portfolio of high-value, competitively held accounts

  • Serve as the primary liaison for assigned accounts, managing communications, expectations, and performance metrics

  • Build and manage executive-level relationships to elevate Avantor’s presence and influence

  • Partner with Sales Representatives, Regional Directors, and VPs to align strategy and execution

  • Coordinate a matrix-selling environment to drive market segment growth and customer satisfaction

  • Develop and execute pricing strategies in collaboration with internal stakeholders to maintain competitiveness and profitability

  • Deliver compelling customer presentations and lead contract proposal efforts for new and existing opportunities

  • Represent Avantor at customer visits, industry events, and internal strategy sessions

Environmental Working Conditions & Physical Effort

Typically works in a home office environment with extensive regional travel to customer locations. Work assignments are diversified. A frequent volume of work and deadlines impose strain on routine basis. Minimal physical effort is required; work is mostly sedentary but may require walking, standing, bending, reaching, or lifting light objects.

Disclaimer

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed and are not intended to be exhaustive. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Why Avantor?

Dare to go further in your career. Join our global team of 14,000+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life-changing science. The work we do changes people’s lives for the better, bringing new patient treatments and therapies to market and enabling medical devices that improve lives. We are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture with learning experiences to support your career growth. Apply today!

Pay Transparency:

The expected pre-tax pay for this position is $121,700.00 - $202,800.00. Actual pay may differ depending on factors such as prior experience and geographic location.

EEO Statement:

We are an Equal Employment/Affirmative Action employer and VEVRAA Federal Contractor. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email with the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. For more information about equal employment opportunity protections, view the Know Your Rights poster.

3rd Party Non-Solicitation Policy:

By submitting candidates without being formally assigned to a specific job requisition, or by failing to comply with the Avantor recruitment process, you may forfeit any fee on submitted candidates. Avantor works with a preferred supplier list and will engage with recruitment agencies based on its needs.

Avantor offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, wellness programs, health savings and flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with company match, and an employee stock purchase program. Employees also receive 11 paid holidays, 18 PTO days annually, volunteer time off, and 6 weeks of 100% paid parental leave (subject to eligibility). These benefits may vary for employees under a collective bargaining agreement or other eligibility rules.

title: Gerente De Estratégia E Escalonamento – Marketplace De Autopeças
description:
Overview

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Type: Full-time

100% Remote

About the Role

We are building the infrastructure of the automotive aftermarket in Latin America, and the Vertical Manager – Auto Parts will own one of its most strategic missions: digitizing and scaling millions of SKUs across Tier 1, 2, and 3, while shaping the future of our marketplace.

This role is designed for someone ready to go beyond Key Account Management and step into a position of ownership, strategy, and impact. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor, commercial instinct, and executional drive to lead the growth of the most critical vertical in our ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vertical Ownership: Define and execute the end-to-end strategy for the auto parts vertical, driving sustainable growth, adoption, and profitability.
  • Catalog Leadership: Build and maintain a digital catalog of millions of SKUs, ensuring accuracy, compatibility, and seamless integration.
  • Strategic Partnerships: Negotiate and manage relationships with Tier 1 OEMs, Tier 2 manufacturers, and Tier 3 distributors to secure competitive assortment and availability.
  • P&L Management: Own key business metrics (GMV, conversion, margins, and supplier performance) and act decisively to improve them.
  • Data-Driven Execution: Use advanced analytics and market intelligence to identify trends, forecast demand, and design growth strategies.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, operations, and tech teams to optimize catalog integration, procurement workflows, and customer experience.
  • Market Vision: Anticipate industry shifts and competitive dynamics to position the marketplace ahead of the curve.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, automotive, or retail category management / business development.
  • Strong track record in catalog management, supplier negotiation, and delivering measurable growth.
  • Excellent analytical skills with proficiency in Excel, SQL, or BI tools.
  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills at senior levels.
  • Fluent in Spanish (Mexico) or Portuguese (Brazil), with advanced English.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead the most strategic vertical in one of the largest industries in Latin America.
  • A role designed for growth, with direct exposure to C-level leadership and investors.
  • A high-impact environment where your decisions shape the future of the business.
  • Competitive compensation package with performance-based incentives.

Salary Reference

  • São Paulo: BRL R$18,900 – R$24,200 gross / month + bonus.

title: Principal Consultant – Soc Transformation And Xsiam Deployment
description:
Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente . Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.

  • Supervisionar, desenvolver e capacitar a equipe de atendimento garantindo a qualidade dos serviços prestados e o cumprimento dos diversos indicadores da área;

  • Elaborar campanhas motivacionais e ações de reconhecimento, engajamento e valorização do colaborador;
  • Realizar interface com as diversas áreas da companhia para solução de problemas e melhorias de processos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Sólida experiência com gestão de equipe;

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge / Zero Trust (SASE / ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.
  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.
  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.
  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.
  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales / engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.
  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

title: Executive Operations Integrator
description:
Overview

Role : Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)

Role Specifics : We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry / salon space.

Contract : Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)

Business Hours : Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

Rate : $2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually (salary is negotiable based on experience and location)

Availability to Start : Immediately

Client's Profile

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.

What You\'ll Do

As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it\'s not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Operations & Integrator Coordination : 60% Role Allocation

Team & Operations Management

  • Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
  • Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
  • Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
  • Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1 : 1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
  • Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
  • Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
  • Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
  • Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
  • Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.

System Management & Process Oversight

  • Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
  • Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
  • Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.

Marketing & Content Coordination : 25% Role Allocation

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
  • Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.

Content Curation & Social Media Management

  • Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, LinkedIn, Google) to align with business initiatives.
  • Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
  • Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.

Strategic Founder & Client Support : 10% Role Allocation

  • Own the Founder\'s calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
  • Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
  • Protect the Founder\'s time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.
  • Communicate with clients as needed, handling urgent escalations, urgent follow-ups and building relationships.

What You Should Have

Must-haves :

  • At least seven years of experience in Executive Support, Operations, or Integrator roles, ideally supporting C-level or Founder Executives.
  • Experience supporting a Founder or Executive in a Beauty, Wellness, or Lifestyle brand, particularly in fast-paced, multi-business environments.
  • At least one year of experience in a global remote or virtual environment for a company or with clients in North America, Europe, Australia, or the UAE.
  • Strong integrator and operational management skills, with the ability to translate high-level strategies into actionable plans and workflows.
  • Mastery of English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional tone and neutral accent for both internal coordination and client correspondence.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage day-to-day operations.
  • Client-facing experience, with the ability to handle escalations professionally and maintain relationships.
  • Hands-on experience with Zenoti (or similar scheduling / inventory systems) and Shopify for backend coordination and updates.
  • Experience in light copywriting, editing, and scheduling social media content across IG, Facebook, LinkedIn, and Google platforms.
  • Proficient in remote office tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) and Slack (or Teams).
  • Experience with project management tools like Asana, Notion, or ClickUp.
  • Proven experience supporting internal operations, maintaining trackers and summary reports (e.g., logins, performance, promos).
  • Exposure to process optimization frameworks, with the ability to implement improvements and create SOPs from scratch.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative without close supervision, and keep executives focused on what matters most.

Technology Specifications :

  • Minimum 100 Mbps Internet Speed
  • Windows 11 or MacOS 15 Sequoia
  • Minimum Intel i5 8th gen with 8GB RAM or Apple M1 chip with 8GB RAM
  • Webcam and Headset
  • Designated Quiet Office Space

Nice-to-haves :

  • Experience with the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) framework, including L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, and IDS.
  • Basic design knowledge for editing branded visual assets in Canva.

Who You Are

We are hoping you are someone who :

  • Naturally steps in to solve problems, keep things moving, and stays a few steps ahead.
  • Thinks clearly and critically, great at untangling complex challenges, spotting what\'s not working, and helping build smoother systems.
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence, whether giving a quick update to the team or coordinating with external partners, you know how to get the message across with emotional intelligence.
  • Keeps everything (and everyone) on track, juggles timelines, priorities, and moving pieces with calm precision and care for the brand image.

  • Sistema Domínio: conhecimento prático e comprovado (eliminatório).
  • Organização, atenção a detalhes, senso de dono e comunicação clara em ambiente remoto.

Nova Cultura

Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega.

Valorizamos profissionais que desejam ter direitos respeitados, mas que também entendem que nossa empresa preza por meritocracia e comprometimento.

Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho, onde quem se dedica, cresce.

Benefícios

  • Vaga 100% remota — Acreditamos de verdade no Home Office. Mas com monitoramento de performance por metas e entregas claras. Utilizamos um programa chamado Jibble, para controle de trabalho remoto.
  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é. Para nós, humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.
  • Feedbacks trimestrais estruturados através do nosso Comitê de Pessoas — Significa que você tem chance real de ser promovido a cada 3 meses, conforme seu desempenho.
  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$500 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pagos 100% pela nossa empresa.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento — Investimos no seu crescimento com cursos pagos pela empresa.
  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e pagamos pela utilização.

Como se candidatar

Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado.

É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.

Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD / ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).

Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Outubro / 25.

Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

Company: 2URN Marketing — performance marketing for roofing & home renovation contractors

Website:

Location: Remote (USA) — Standard hours 9:00–5:00 PM CDT

Type: Full-time (open to contractor-to-hire)

Why this role exists

We create ads that make the phone ring for roofers. You’ll turn raw ideas and footage into scroll-stopping creative, edit content fast, and support campaign execution. If you can edit content at a high level, you’re a #1-priority candidate—design skills matter, but content editing chops win.

What you’ll do (outcomes, not busywork)

  • Produce ad creative: Design static graphics and short-form video for Meta / TikTok / YouTube / Display; iterate quickly based on performance data.
  • Edit content end-to-end: Cut UGC, before / after, job-site clips; add captions, hooks, overlays, CTAs; ship multiple variations.
  • Build offer / angle packs: Translate roofing value props (financing, storm damage, warranties, same-day inspection) into hooks, headlines, and visuals.
  • Launch + maintain assets: Prep export specs, thumbnails, landing page hero graphics, and ad library organization.
  • Brand standards: Create and maintain lightweight brand kits per client (logos, palettes, typography, truck / crew photos).
  • Creative testing: Set up A / B creative matrices; document learnings; kill losers, scale winners.
  • Light marketing ops: Assist with ad uploads, naming conventions, UTM hygiene, and creative calendars.
  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • $500–$1,000 per month (DOE) + performance bonus tied to creative wins.
  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.
  • Growth path: Senior Creative → Creative Lead (own testing roadmap and junior designers).

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Portfolio link + 2–3 ad examples with a one-liner on why they worked
  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)
  • 2 static ads (before / after + financing angle)
  • Project file + export settings + a one-page rationale

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for skill, speed, and integrity. All backgrounds welcome.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making.

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

Como Técnico de Teste , você será responsável por:

title: Netsuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location : Remote – Brazil

Salary : USD 1,700 / month

Schedule : 40 hours / week

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.

Key Responsibilities

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.

Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.

Our platform offers a wide range of proctoring and invigilation options.

Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don\'t need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You\'ll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder\'s priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include :

Team & Operations Management

  • Turn the Founder\'s ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.

What You Should Have

Overview

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers\' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

Additional Information

The Team

The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Here’s What You’ll Get To Work On:

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Here’s the experience we’re looking for:

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

Here’s what we’re looking for this role to achieve:

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

description:
Area Manager - Outbound & Delivery, Fulfillment Center

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. Since our founding in 1994, we've grown from an online bookstore to a global technology leader in e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence.

We distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers across more than 100 countries. Our innovative spirit drives us to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible in logistics and delivery.

As we continue to expand our operations, we're seeking exceptional leaders who share our passion for innovation and customer obsession. At Amazon, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects, collaborate with world-class talent, and make a tangible impact on millions of customers' lives.

Role Overview: As an Area Manager - Outbound and Delivery, you will play a crucial role in our complex and fast-paced logistics network. This dynamic position combines responsibilities across our Fulfillment Center (FC) and Delivery Station (DS) operations, requiring a versatile leader who can seamlessly manage both outbound processes and delivery preparations.

You'll be at the forefront of our customer-facing operations, ensuring that millions of packages are processed efficiently and prepared for timely delivery. Your focus will span four key areas: safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop a team of warehouse associates and delivery personnel, oversee performance, provide training, and address team member needs.
  • Operational Management: Review work forecasts and set productivity targets to meet overall building objectives, oversee the outbound process from order fulfillment to last-mile delivery preparation.
  • Safety & Compliance: Implement and support all safety programs and ensure OSHA compliance, maintain a safe work environment for all associates in both FC and DS areas.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and lead process improvement initiatives using Lean tools, analyze metrics to find root causes and drive operational enhancements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Liaise with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth outbound and delivery operations, communicate daily metrics and report exceptions to relevant departments.

A day in the life: Work flexible schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays as required, operate in both Fulfillment Center and Delivery Station settings, thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced atmosphere.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Can push and pull wheeled dollies loaded with products up to 100 pounds during shifts
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in Portuguese
  • Employee and performance management experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities.   • Vanta Platform Utilization: Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)

  • Vendor Risk Management: Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support: Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness: Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics: Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated: Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment

  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement

Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

  • Industry learning: Rapidly absorb what makes roofing ads work: seasonality, storm events, insurance language, compliance “do’s and don’ts.”

Must-have skills & experience

  • 2–5+ years in graphic design and / or content editing (agency, in-house, or freelance). Roofing / home services / renovation background strongly preferred.
  • Editor-first: Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, or Final Cut + After Effects basics. Figma / Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop proficiency.
  • Proven portfolio of direct-response creative (ads that sell, not just look pretty).
  • Strong sense of hooks, pacing, and clarity; understands attention economics for 3–30s ads.
  • Comfortable working from raw, imperfect footage (phone clips, job-site audio) and making it look sharp.
  • Solid copy instincts: headlines, overlays, lower-thirds, CTA placement.
  • Organized: version control, file naming, and asset libraries.

Nice-to-haves

  • Roofing / home services portfolio (before / after, crew, drone, hail / storm angles).
  • UGC direction: writing briefs, coaching talent, shot lists.
  • Basic landing page design (Figma / Webflow / Canva) and thumbnail optimization.

What success looks like (90-day scorecard)

  • Ship 30–50 creative variations / month across clients (mix of video + static).
  • Hit ≥ 3 winning creatives / month (defined as 20–40%+ lift in CTR / CVR vs. control).
  • Build / maintain client brand kits and a searchable asset library.
  • Document a Creative Playbook for roofing offers, angles, and compliance.

KPIs you’ll own

  • Thumb-stop / 3-sec view rate (shorts / reels).
  • CTR on first-touch ads; CPL contribution for lead gen funnels.
  • Creative velocity: variants shipped per week and on-time rate.
  • Iteration speed: time from data insight → new variant live.

Tools we use

Adobe CC (Premiere / AE / PS / AI) or CapCut Pro, Figma, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, Meta Ads Library, Frame.io (or equivalent).

Work setup

Fully remote. Standard working hours 9:00–5:00 PM Central (CDT). Occasional optional travel for content capture or team onsites.

Compensation

  • Benefits (if full-time): PTO, holidays, gear stipend, education budget.

How to apply

Apply via our website: (Careers / Contact). Include:

  • Your tool stack + availability
  • Confirmation you can work 9:00–5:00 PM CDT (align your timezone)

Paid test (required)

We’ll give you a raw roofing job-site folder (clips + stills). In 48 hours, deliver:

  • 2 x 15s vertical ads (3 hook variants each)

Role expectations (how we work)

  • Iterate fast. Done > perfect; perfect comes from rounds of data-driven edits.
  • Own the result. If CPL is high, you propose creative fixes—don’t wait for orders.
  • Be practical. Clarity beats clever. Results beat awards.

Equal Opportunity

We hire for skill, speed, and integrity. All backgrounds welcome.

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world. Summary

As a Technical Product Marketing Specialist at Latitude.sh, you’ll bridge the gap between product, engineering, and marketing to accelerate the adoption of our global bare-metal platform. You’ll craft narratives and technical stories that resonate with infrastructure decision-makers — from developers and platform engineers to heads of cloud — translating complex infrastructure capabilities into clear, differentiated business value.

This role plays a key part in how we position and launch new technical capabilities, educate the market on why bare metal makes modern workloads succeed, and help customers understand how to build faster, more efficient platforms on top of Latitude.sh.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop technical narratives and enablement content (from guides and whitepapers to supporting the development of solution briefs, blog posts, and product pages) that articulate the value of our bare-metal solutions and accelerate user adoption.
  • Increase product awareness within the DevOps community and drive product adoption by expanding the user base and activating existing users.
  • Scale production of technical assets that showcase how our platform solves real-world problems in cloud infrastructure and across different verticals like Web3, AI/ML, SaaS, and edge computing.
  • Track and analyze product-marketing performance metrics to provide actionable insights that refine messaging, guide product strategy, and inform go-to-market priorities.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and networking teams to translate complex infrastructure features into clear customer-facing benefits across different content formats.
  • Develop and refine our technical personas, conduct surveys, and synthesize customer insights to inform product direction, feature prioritization, and messaging strategies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistent storytelling, technical accuracy, and seamless execution of product marketing initiatives across campaigns, product releases, and customer touchpoints.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product marketing experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps platforms, or B2B technology (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, or similar technical products).
  • Strong project management skills with experience driving cross-functional launches and initiatives across product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to craft technical positioning and messaging that drives adoption and shapes market perception.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience measuring success and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Highly self-motivated and collaborative, thriving in a fast-paced, global, remote-first environment.
  • Hands-on experience creating and editing technical content (e.g., architecture diagrams, documentation, SDK/CLI guides, technical blog posts) is a strong plus.

What do we offer?

  • Contractor (PJ)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Competitive Compensation
  • Wellhub (former Gympass)
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance
  • Work Anniversary bonus

Why Latitude.sh?

We\'re a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem-solving. As part of our team, you won\'t be lost in the crowd – you\'ll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one.

Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We\'re proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, or disability. If these values speak to you, we\'d love for you to become a part of our team.

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers.   • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite.

  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits / credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.

  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client

Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on, and purpose-driven AI Engineer to strengthen our product and consulting solutions. This will serve as your entry point into a broader journey of scaling our AI methodologies across the platform. What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute model evaluation strategies to benchmark LLMs and ensure reliability.
  • Develop human-in-the-loop systems that balance automation with expert oversight.
  • Explore and deploy AI agents to support discovery, classification, and recommendation workflows.

  • 2+ years of experience working directly with LLMs (development, deployment, or applied research).

  • Experience with RAG, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop pipelines.

  • Bonus: experience with Google Vertex AI or AI Studio.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, able to move from concept to working prototype in short cycles.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable in a flexible, fully remote, task-based environment.
  • Fluent in English
  • Passion for building technologies that drive systemic social and environmental impact.

Why Mútua?

  • Competitive early-stage compensation with clear pathway to equity (stock options).
  • Fully remote, flexible, and outcome-oriented work environment.
  • Opportunity to consolidate your career as an AI Engineer working on the frontier of LLM applications.
  • Direct access to Google experts and resources, thanks to our $250k grant.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture that values growth, learning, and innovation.

Join us at Mútua

Be part of a team pioneering essential infrastructure for the global impact ecosystem, while building your career at the cutting edge of applied AI.

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. Help shape the future of our team by attracting and hiring top talent for a fast-growing international company.

description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações, não deixe de se aplicar. Focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.

Regime : PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral

Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A / B / C / D até grandes multinacionais.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida / efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.

Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.

Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.

Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
About MeetGeek

MeetGeek is an AI meeting assistant that doesn't just listen, it acts. We help teams automate meeting capture, summarization, and now, with agentic AI workflows, MeetGeek becomes an active participant in meetings, surfacing data, triggering automations, and even taking actions on your behalf.

From Zoom to Teams to Google Meet, MeetGeek integrates with 5,000+ tools like HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, and more — helping revenue, product, and operations teams turn conversations into structured workflows.

Thousands of companies in 100+ countries already trust us. Backed by top-tier investors and led by a team of AI, NLP, and systems engineering veterans, MeetGeek is redefining what meetings can do.

It\'s a great time to join MeetGeek. We’re a quickly growing remote team, well-funded, and helping thousands of teams improve their meetings.

About MeetGeek

We’re looking for a Customer Success Representative (Junior) who’s passionate about helping customers succeed — and curious about what’s next in AI, automation, and workflow design.

This role blends customer support, customer success, and operations. You’ll help users go beyond meeting notes and unlock the full power of MeetGeek’s agentic capabilities — from automated follow-ups to real-time action triggers.

About the Role

  • Technical Troubleshooting — Support users through questions about agent setup, integrations, or system behavior. Collaborate with engineering to resolve edge cases.
  • Customer Onboarding & Success — Guide new customers from kickoff to activation. Help teams integrate MeetGeek into daily operations, measure value, and drive adoption.
  • CRM & Billing Ownership — Manage Stripe billing flows (upgrades and cancellations). Ensure customers have clarity on billing and account status.
  • Knowledge & Self-Service Support — Contribute to our help center and knowledge base by creating and updating articles, troubleshooting guides, and best practices.
  • Source Expansion Opportunities for Sales — Identify new opportunities during support and customer interactions. Surface warm leads and expansion potential to the sales team.

About You

  • 2–3 years in a customer-facing SaaS role (Customer Support, Onboarding, Sales Engineer)
  • You\u2019ve built automation flows before (Zapier, Make, bots, API triggers, etc.)
  • Consultative and empathetic — you love helping users streamline and optimize
  • Familiar with tools like Slack, Intercom, Notion, Google Workspace, CRMs
  • Fluent in English, and other language required (French, German or Spanish)

Benefits & perks

  • Work remotely
  • Competitive salary and equity
  • Bonus via Bonusly (rewards and recognition)
  • Being part of a rockstar team
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology

Are you up for a new challenge?

Does joining as an early employee at a well-funded and high-potential AI start-up sound good to you?

If so, just drop a link to your LinkedIn profile here (that\'s really all we need). If it looks like a fit, we\'ll be in touch with you very soon.

Before you apply

At MeetGeek, we\'re all about pushing boundaries and aiming high, which makes for an awesome learning and growth experience. But it also means we expect a lot from each other. If you\'re excited about the role and ready to give it your best, don’t hesitate to apply.

About us

MeetGeek was founded in 2020 by 3 technical co-founders with significant experience in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing, and is backed by EarlyGame Ventures, one of the leading venture capital firms in Romania (UI Path’s den).
